item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #MINPRSD
Issued at 06:30 AM 22 November 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #ZamboangaDelNorte(LaLibertad, DipologCity, DapitanCity, Polanco, Piñan, Sibutad, Rizal, Mutia, Pres.ManuelA.Roxas, Manukan, Katipunan), #SurigaoDelNorte(SanFrancisco, Malimono, Mainit, Placer, Tubod), #SurigaoDelSur(Cortes, CityOfTandag, Carmen, Madrid, Carrascal and Cantilan) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #SurigaoDelNorte(SurigaoCity, Sison, TaganaAn), #SurigaoDelSur(Lanuza) and #AgusanDelNorte(Nasipit) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
